description: Hoplite is a cloud coding-agent platform for starting, supervising, and reviewing work in GitHub-backed repositories. It runs agent work in managed cloud workspaces and can return repository changes and pull requests for human review.
summary: Hoplite exposes one organization-scoped HTTP API at `https://api.hoplite.sh`, one OAuth/API-key-protected MCP server at `https://api.hoplite.sh/mcp`, and an official `hoplite` CLI distributed via npm and Homebrew.
